action:bankworld/core/simulation.execute: The bank world's dispatcher: every bank command a screen runs goes through it, and each command is its own row.
action:bankworld/index.advanceBankWorld: Brings the bank to the game's clock before a bank command runs; time passing is proven through the scheduled rows and the bank commands.
action:bankworld/index.bankSim: Reads the bank world for the command that follows; not a decision.
action:personal.takeHomeAvailable: Reads how much may come home, inside the Take Home action, which is its own row.
action:song-actions.syncMusicTasks: Follows a song change with the work it now needs; the song changes are their own rows.
action:song-actions.syncSongTasks: Follows a song change with the work it now needs; the song changes are their own rows.
action:state.adoptPlace: Makes a chosen place known to the world; the place field that chose it is the row.
action:time.formatDateKey: Formats a date inside a change; not a decision.
scheduled:birthday: A notice: it tells the player their age has changed. Age itself is read from the birth date wherever it matters (casting, licences), never from this event; switched off, nothing else changed (docs/v10/proof/off-birthday.json).
scheduled:edition-deadline-soon: A notice: it tells the player an entry deadline is near. The deadline that closes entries is its own system (edition-deadline), proven separately.
scheduled:screening-reminder: A notice: it tells the player a screening they were invited to is near. Attending is the screening itself and the RSVP, proven separately.
scheduled:job-lapse: Record-keeping: on an unanswered offer's last day it marks the offer lapsed, for your list and the record. The deadline itself is enforced when you answer (jobs.ts acceptRefusal: "That offer has lapsed."), so with this event switched off an offer still can't be taken late; nothing else reads the mark (docs/v10/proof/off-job-lapse.json).
scheduled:opportunity-expire: Record-keeping: on an unanswered proposal's last day it marks it lapsed, for your list. The deadline is enforced when you answer (opportunities.ts acceptOpportunity checks expiresAt), so with this event switched off a proposal still can't be taken late; nothing else reads the mark (docs/v10/proof/off-opportunity-expire.json).
action:hiring.castRoleFor: Names the job a part's casting method is (performer or voice performer) inside an offer; the offer is its own row (hiring.makeOffer).
action:projects.renameDraft: Names a draft; the name is shown in the draft list and nothing else reads it, as a label shouldn't be.
action:brief.saveIdea: Keeps an idea on the player's shortlist in the idea picker (IdeaPicker.tsx); the idea itself is used through the brief, its own row.
action:company.setBanner: Names your banner, shown on your credits as "A … Production" (YourMoney.tsx); a name, read only where it is shown.
action:song-actions.setSongPerformers: Names who sings a song, shown in the credits as "Song Performed By" (songs.ts) and in a casting note; a name, read only where it is shown.
scheduled:permit-decision: Decides a work permit applied for before November 14, 2026, which older saves still hold (papers.ts "what older saves hold"); nothing in a new story schedules it, and permits now go through Your Papers (papers-decision).
scheduled:company-decision: Withdraws a company registration an older save had pending: companies left the game (v9 step 6), and nothing in a new story schedules it.
scheduled:family-repayment: Takes a month's repayment of a family loan chosen in an older save's creation: a new story starts with the inheritance and no family terms (personal.ts openPersonalMoney), so nothing in it schedules this.
scheduled:industry-decision: Renews or ends the real series the world follows, as the catalog's world pages show them (catalog/world.ts, simseason.ts); nothing in a player's career reads those outcomes.
scheduled:plan-reminder: A reminder in the log before a plan starts; the plan itself is proven (plan-over-call, cancel-plan), and the reminder decides nothing.
scheduled:papers-expiry: Marks a visa or permit expired on its date and tells you to apply again. Whether it still lets you in or lets you work is read from its date wherever that matters (papers.ts entryRight, permitIn), so the stage it sets changes only the words.
field:Shell.tsx#\"Advance To\"#1: How far to let the clock run. Time passing is the engine every proof plays a career through; what happens by a date is each system's own row, and Advance stopping for a plan or a call is tested (tests/foundation.test.ts::Advance stops at a reminder).
field:Shell.tsx#\"Date\"#1: How far to let the clock run. Time passing is the engine every proof plays a career through; what happens by a date is each system's own row, and Advance stopping for a plan or a call is tested (tests/foundation.test.ts::Advance stops at a reminder).
field:Shell.tsx#\"Time\"#1: How far to let the clock run. Time passing is the engine every proof plays a career through; what happens by a date is each system's own row, and Advance stopping for a plan or a call is tested (tests/foundation.test.ts::Advance stops at a reminder).
field:MusicCatalog.tsx#\"Their Role\"#1: A filter of the music catalog: it narrows who is listed (tests/music-catalog.test.ts::finds people by name and role). Choosing someone listed is the decision, and those are their own rows.
field:Places.tsx#\"Reminder\"#1: When a plan's reminder comes: a notice, as its event is (scheduled:plan-reminder above). A plan you sleep through is marked missed, and nothing reads a missed plan.
field:Startup.tsx#{`Replacement Place ${: A repair of a save whose places can't be found: it puts a place where the save had one (tests/migration.test.ts::open after a repair that keeps a backup and changes only the places). Where you live, the decision a place makes, is proven by base-los-angeles.
field:WorkViews.tsx#\"Music By\"#1: Names typed for a song that existed before the film, carried to its credits (songs.ts songCredits). An award for an original song takes only one written for the project (awards-rules.ts writtenForProject), so these names never decide an entry; who writes a song made for the film is its own row (Where It Comes From, Lyrics).
field:WorkViews.tsx#\"Lyrics By\"#1: Names typed for a song that existed before the film, carried to its credits (songs.ts songCredits). An award for an original song takes only one written for the project (awards-rules.ts writtenForProject), so these names never decide an entry; who writes a song made for the film is its own row (Where It Comes From, Lyrics).
field:MusicCatalog.tsx#\"Find A Composer: A search of the music catalog: it narrows who and what is listed (tests/music-catalog.test.ts::finds people by name and role), as the role filter beside it does. Licensing a recording or considering a composer found is the decision, proven by license-recording and consider-composer.
action:homes/index.arrangeViewing: Information, not a decision (from November 17, 2026): a viewing on its day says what can be seen of a home, its floors and walls, roof and heating, and what is shared; no engine function reads that it happened, and the price and terms are the same either way. tests/homes.test.ts shows it comes on its day, once.
action:homes/index.toggleFavorite: A bookmark (from November 17, 2026): it keeps a home in Find A Home's list after its month so you can find it again; it changes no price, term or outcome. e2e/homes.spec.ts shows a saved home kept and lapsing on its own date.
scheduled:your-film-release: A notice: on its release date it tells you a studio picture you made has opened, with its first week, and reads your grades again. The picture's box office, its reception in your craft and its place in the awards are all read from its release date (your-films.ts), not from this event, so switching it off changes only the news.
